turns.reply: The regex range `\u0020-\u006f` stops at `o`, so `p` through `~` fall off the fast path. I'll extend it to `\u007e`, which covers all printable ASCII.

turns.reply: The fast-path regex in `rich/cells.py` stopped at `\u006f` ('o'), so printable ASCII from 'p' to '~' was pushed off the single-width fast path. I changed the range end to `\u007e` ('~'); the regex now matches strings like `'hello world pqrs~'`, `tests/test_cells.py` passes, and the patch is submitted (1 file changed).
